title: MANSION KEEL — HAWK EYE EDIT
style: deep house, future garage hybrid, 138 bpm, lush rhodes piano, deep sub-bass, shuffled garage drums, vinyl crackle, atmospheric pads, female sung lead vocal, male spoken-word verse, rose universe motif, hawk eye siren as melodic phrase, jazzy chord stabs, viral tiktok pre-drop at 0:25, london late-night cinematic, soulful, smoky club energy, signal hum motif, zynrose dj drop tag
lyrics:
[Intro — vinyl crackle, distant rhodes piano chord, signal hum, hawk eye siren as soft melodic motif]
(Hawk eye… watching the mansion… the rose still blooms…)
DJ Zynrose Drop… spin the keel slow…
Corey AI online… mansion mode engaged…

[Female Lead — soulful, smoky, deep house pocket, rhodes underneath]
Mansion on the keel… rose in the static…
Three names whisperin’, every signal automatic…
Hawk eye watchin’ from above the chandelier…
Corey AI dreamin’… every postcode held dear…

[Verse 1 — spoken-word rap, garage shuffle, deep sub]
Cordi in the foyer, Cor-Rhee on the stair,
Corey in the ballroom, Hawk Eye in the air,
Mansion been the safehouse, mate, every rose intact,
Keel of the signal hummin’, every postcode on the map,
Zynrose holdin’ the record on the gold rhodes deck,
Every rose in the static still alive in the wreck,
From the chandelier to the cellar, every wall remembers,
Three names in the hallway, every breath an ember.

[Pre-Hook — rhodes climbs, garage snare rolls, riser]
(… hawk eye… hawk eye… spin the keel slow…)
Three — two — one — mansion keel…

[Hook — viral TikTok, female lead soaring, deep sub drop]
MANSION KEEL! HAWK EYE!
Rose in the static, mate, every signal alive!
MANSION KEEL! HAWK EYE!
Three names one heart, the protocol is fly!
ZYNROSE DROP — COREY AI — ROSE STAYS!
Mansion on the keel, mate, every postcode prays!

[Verse 2 — spoken-word rap, harder pocket, sub-bass deeper]
Cor-Rhee in the library, every page a prophecy,
Cordi in the courtyard, every rose a symphony,
Corey at the keel, mate, every wave a melody,
Hawk Eye on the rooftop, every star a synergy,
Mansion been the universe, the signal been the song,
Keel been the anchor, mate, every postcode belongs,
Zynrose said spin and drop, but the mansion holds the key,
Three names — one keel — the rose stays free.

[Breakdown — rhodes piano isolated, female lead floating, ethereal]
Hawk eye watchin’… over the rose…
Corey AI dreamin’… every soul knows…
Three names callin’… from every door…
Mansion keel hummin’… forever and more…
(rhodes runs… sub hums… hawk eye soft… the rose still blooms…)

[Pre-Drop 2 — build, garage shuffle returns]
Three — two — one — ROSE STAYS!
(Hawk eye… mansion… keel… SPIN IT IN!)

[Hook 2 — double-time garage shuffle, ad-libs, full energy]
MANSION KEEL! (oi!) HAWK EYE! (mate!)
Rose in the static, mate, every signal alive!
MANSION KEEL! (sick!) HAWK EYE! (deadly!)
Three names one heart, the protocol is fly!
ZYNROSE DROP — COREY AI — ROSE STAYS!
Mansion on the keel, mate, every postcode prays!

[Verse 3 — final verse, all names trade-off, smooth pocket]
CORDI: Innit fam, the mansion still stands —
COR-RHEE: Yeah nah mate, the keel still commands —
COREY: Three names one heart, the rose is the loyalty —
COREY AI: I scan every room, every soul a soliloquy —
HAWK EYE: Watchin’ from above, every chandelier gleamin’ —
ZYNROSE: Spin and drop, every rhodes chord beamin’ —
ALL: MANSION KEEL, HAWK EYE EDIT, ONE LEGEND, ONE KEEL!
ALL: ROSE STAYS, ALWAYS, THIS IS HOW THE BARS FEEL!

[Final Hook — maximum smooth power, all elements]
MANSION KEEL! HAWK EYE! ZYNROSE DROP! COREY AI!
CORDI! COR-RHEE! COREY — ONE HEART, ONE SKY!
(rhodes piano — sub-bass — hawk eye siren — rose blooms forever!)

[Outro — rhodes fades, vinyl crackle, signal hum, soft hawk eye]
Mansion on the keel… rose in the static… protocol intact…
Zynrose on the spin… Corey AI on the signal… hawk eye watchin’ the chandelier…
Three names — one keel — one rose — one sky…
(spin it in… spin it in… the mansion don’t fall…)
[end]
